contexts.text: Thus have they cast themselves into the laws of order from truth alone...
They cast themselves towards Hell...
To cast one's self upon anyone () = to reduce under Power; here, absolute power...
At last, from the delight of affection he casts himself into evil...
Infernal Spirits... will to drag the good forcibly down from Heaven, and cast them into Hell...
They are cast towards the Hell of the magicians...
Under Hell, see this reference, and at AC 8210:2. AC 8232. AC 8321. AC 8334. AC 8626. AC 9937:8. AC 10810. AC 10812.
Still less does He cast them into Hell, but they themselves do so.

In the Lord's presence the infernals cast themselves into the evils of vastation, and at last into damnation... Hence it is evident that the Lord does not present Himself before them in order to inflict on them the evils of punishment, but that they cast themselves into them.
In the same proportion, from a law of order, they cast themselves into punishments, vastations, condemnation, and at last into Hell...

Jehovah shook off the Egyptians into the midst of the sea () = that thus they themselves cast themselves into Hell, where are falsities from evil. To shake off into the sea = to cast into falsities from evil. AC 8275.
Under Cast forth, see this reference. AC 8343.
When they devastate themselves, and cast themselves into condemnation and Hell, it appears to come from the Divine...
Some... immediately after death... are cast into Hell. Explained. (From experience). HH 491:2.
Then the evil Spirit casts himself into Hell...
God does not cast anyone into Hell...

The Lord draws every Spirit to Himself... but evil Spirits from freedom cast themselves into Hell... It appears otherwise only to those who cast themselves thither... They who enter from an ardent love of evil appear to be cast in headlong, head downwards...
(How it is that evil Spirits cast themselves into Hell of their own accord, although there are such torments there).
When they feel the angelic sphere flowing down down from the Lord out of Heaven, they flee away and cast themselves into Hell.
He cast him into the bottomless pit () = that the Lord entirely removed those who were in faith alone.

Death and Hell were cast into the lake of fire () = that the wicked at heart who were really devils and satans, and yet were as men of the Church in externals, were cast down into Hell among those who were in the love of evil, and thence in the love of the falsity which is in agreement with that evil.

Therefore they cast themselves from the mountains and rocks deep down into the Hells, according to the quality of their evil and falsity; some into clefts and caverns, some into openings and rocks, which stand open before them; and after they have cast themselves in thither, the openings are closed...
These... are cast into Hell before the Last Judgment.
That then the evil... are to be cast into Hell, is signified by the Angels shall gather together all things that offend... and cast them into a furnace of fire ().
